info.title: Kirby GB/GBC Emulator
info.author: Yarik
info.description: Based on GameLad NX by Dooskington, Ange
info.details:
A custom Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator for Nintendo Switch, based on the open-source GameLad NX project.

Features:

· Custom UI: A stylish menu with game list, scrolling, and a clock.
· Themes: Choose between classic Game Boy Green, Kirby Pink/Purple, and Black & White.
· Controls: Remappable buttons and Fast Forward (ZR).
· Splash Screen: Custom boot screen with the author's name.
· Easy to use: Just put your .gb / .gbc files in sd:/switch/KirbyGB/roms/ and play.

Credits:
Based on GameLad NX by Dooskington, AngelXex, and tcfritchman (MIT License). Huge thanks to the original authors!


AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
